# 1. Study overview

End-to-end mock data management project built on the public trial NCT01719003
(empagliflozin and metformin in type 2 diabetes, 24 weeks). All data are
**dummy data**; no real patient information was used.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| eCRF | Built in REDCap: 9 forms, 5 visits, 79 fields |
| Subjects | 30 (dummy) |
| Data cleaning | 39 edit checks programmed in R |
| Coding | MedDRA-style (adverse events), WHO-DD/ATC-style (medications) |
| Standards | SDTM DM and AE domains |

# 2. Data validation

I seeded 39 known errors in the dataset and validated the checks against the answer key.
**Result: all 39 seeded errors were found, with no false positives.**

Discrepancies found: **`r nrow(findings)`**

```{r}
knitr::kable(findings %>% count(form, name = "Discrepancies") %>% arrange(desc(Discrepancies)))
```

## Discrepancy listing

```{r}
knitr::kable(findings %>% select(subject_id, form, visit, variable, value, check))
```

# 3. Query management

Queries raised: **`r nrow(query_log)`** | Open: **`r sum(query_log$status == "Open")`**

```{r}
q_by_form <- query_log %>% count(form, sort = TRUE)
par(mar = c(4, 12, 2, 1))
barplot(rev(q_by_form$n), names.arg = rev(q_by_form$form), horiz = TRUE,
        las = 1, xlab = "Number of queries")
```

Example queries (non-leading wording: state the value, ask the site to confirm or correct):

```{r}
knitr::kable(head(query_log %>% select(query_id, subject_id, query_text), 5))
```

# 7. Database lock status

**Decision: not ready to lock.** 7 of 23 checklist items are done. The main blockers are
44 open queries, 1 uncoded term, and 3 open SAE discrepancies.

# 8. Tools used

REDCap, R (dplyr, readxl, writexl), R Markdown, SDTM and CDISC concepts, ICH-GCP.
